_comment: Nutrients tracked by Complex Nutrition. Food profiles store macros in g, calories in kcal and micronutrients in % of the daily value per 100 g. Daily values for micronutrients are the US FDA adult Daily Values (21 CFR 101.9), as listed by NIH ODS; macro targets are the game's own design targets. Tracking (v0.2) keeps a reserve per nutrient in % of its daily target. Since v0.2.2 calories are a tank filled only by digestion, and fat, protein and carbohydrate are gut pools whose size comes from config/digestion.json (their cap here is set to match, and is replaced by it on load); they do not drain or use the sitting limit. For the rest: cap is the most the body stores, startReserve what a new character starts with, drainPerDay what a day uses (calories follow the game's hunger rate instead), and sittingLimit the intake in one sitting above which the extra is absorbed at a falling rate. drainPerDay and sittingLimit default to 100 and 150. displayUnit is the unit amounts are shown in (kcal, g, mg or mcg; none for the B vitamins, which are a mix of six and always shown in %), and dvAmount how much of it makes 100% of the daily value.

nutrients.source: Design target: an active day (FDA reference is 2,000 kcal). The tank holds 7 active days
Design target: 1.6 g per kg of bodyweight for an 80 kg character (FDA DV 50 g). Bodyweight comes in v0.7
Mean %DV of thiamin (1.2 mg), riboflavin (1.3 mg), niacin (16 mg), B6 (1.7 mg), folate (400 mcg DFE) and B12 (2.4 mcg), each capped at 300%
